title: Two Prudential Plaza
status: Original source reconstruction; dimensional and geographic review pending

references.notes: Floor 28 and 30 plans show the signed north arrow, the long north-south rectangle, projecting central north/south bays, four re-entrant corners and facade subdivisions. East is Stetson/Lake Michigan; south is Randolph/Millennium Park. The two floors differ in corner treatment. No dimensions or usable drawing scale are printed. Roughly 22,000 square feet is a marketed area and must not be treated as gross footprint area. Cover page contains only branding.

Contact sheet inspected: skyline context, Lake Street Plaza, entrance paving and planters, tall glazed lobby walls and the connection with One Prudential. Roof terrace views belong to the shared complex and must not automatically be attached to the top of Two Prudential. Crown geometry remains partly occluded in these views; further closeups/elevations are needed.
Do not extrapolate every facade level by dividing total spire height by storeys.

Confirms 995 ft height and the concrete construction system. The same page calls it 60 stories in its data and 68 stories in prose; these counts conflict with each other and with the registry's 64. Do not silently combine them.
Text describes chevron setbacks, a pyramidal crown rotated 45 degrees, an 80 ft spire and a lobby connection to One Prudential. Photographs have not yet been inspected.

references.inspected: Full exterior, full-resolution mid-tower chevrons and crown. Pale granite piers and spandrels, recessed blue glazing, central glazed strips, sloping metal setback caps and horizontal crown bands. Photographic proportions do not establish surveyed dimensions.
